description.zh:
是否扩散统计类消息，打开时在加入消息组后会广播消息组的统计信息，客户端可以接收处理该消息。取值：

- true：扩散统计类消息。

- false：不扩散统计类消息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to broadcast statistics messages. When enabled, the statistics information of the message group will be broadcast after joining the message group, and the client can receive and process this message. Valid values:

- true: Broadcast statistics messages.
- false: Do not broadcast statistics messages.

description.zh:
系统消息扩散类型，取值：

- 0（默认值）：不扩散。

- 1：扩散到指定人。

- 2：扩散到群组。
description.en:
System message diffusion type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): No diffusion.
- 1: Diffusion to specified users.
- 2: Diffusion to the group.

description.zh: 用户UserId，用户自定义，在AppId下单独唯一。
description.en: User ID, which is customized by the user and must be unique under the AppId.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

The QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You can call this API properly to avoid issues. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live leave-message-group --app-id VKL3000 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id de100a0 --broad-cast-type 2 --broad-cast-statistics true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live LeaveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId VKL3000 --BroadCastType 2 --UserId de100a0 --BroadCastStatistics true --GroupId 'AE35-0000-T95F'
